## Settings › Routing set: add SRC_2 to Sources (a name with no row: POST at the end of its role)
  1  POST /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
       {
         "core_node_name": "SRC_2",
         "role": "source",
         "label": "SRC_2",
         "enabled": true,
         "sequence": 3
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
-- sheet closed
-- routing warning "", error ""

## Settings › Routing set: add DST_9 to Destinations (a switched-off row: PATCH adopts it)
  1  PATCH /api/processes/1/routing-nodes/109
       {
         "enabled": true
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
-- sheet closed
-- routing warning "", error ""

## Settings › Routing set: × STG_3 out of Staging (DELETE, and the warning it answers)
  1  DELETE /api/processes/1/routing-nodes/105
  2  GET /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
-- sheet closed
-- routing warning "STG_3 is still named by Style A.", error ""

## Settings › Routing set: click STG_1, already in Staging (the picker takes it out)
  1  DELETE /api/processes/1/routing-nodes/103
  2  GET /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
-- sheet closed
-- routing warning "STG_1 is still named by Style A.", error ""

## Settings › Routing set: Turn all 1 on (Staging)
  1  PATCH /api/processes/1/routing-nodes/106
       {
         "enabled": true
       }
  2  GET /api/processes/1/routing-nodes
  3  GET /api/processes
  4  GET /api/processes/1/composer
  5  GET /api/processes/1/styles
  6  GET /api/process-nodes
  7  GET /api/processes/1/station-counters
  8  GET /api/processes/1/counting-slots
  9  GET /api/processes/1/catid-health
-- sheet closed
